description:
Our client is a well-established Vietnamese business group with diversified operations across multiple industries and a growing portfolio of subsidiaries and affiliated companies.
As part of its continued organisational development, the Client is seeking an experienced Group Chief Accountant to oversee and strengthen its financial and accounting management across the entire organisation.
The successful candidate will play a key role in establishing financial governance, standardising accounting systems, overseeing consolidated reporting and optimising financial resources across the Group's multi-entity structure.
This is a senior leadership position offering broad exposure to Group-level financial management, corporate finance and organisational transformation.
Key Responsibilities
1. Group Accounting & Financial Reporting
* Lead and standardise accounting policies, procedures and systems across the Group and its subsidiaries.
* Establish consistent accounting standards and practices across multiple business entities, ensuring compliance with Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) and supporting the transition towards international reporting standards.
* Oversee the preparation and consolidation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements.
* Manage financial closing processes and ensure the accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting.
* Develop management reporting systems to monitor business performance, revenue, costs, profitability and budget variances.
2. Tax Management & Compliance
* Develop and oversee the Group's overall tax strategy and tax planning activities.
* Ensure tax compliance across subsidiaries and manage tax-related risks, including transfer pricing.
* Oversee tax audits, inspections and engagement with relevant authorities.
* Work with external auditors and professional advisors on complex accounting and tax matters.
3. Corporate Finance & Treasury Management
* Establish and oversee centralised cash management and treasury operations across the Group.
* Develop and monitor short-, medium- and long-term cash flow forecasts to ensure liquidity.
* Lead the annual budgeting and financial planning process across business units.
* Monitor budget allocation and utilisation, ensuring alignment with the Group's strategic objectives.
* Work closely with the CFO and financial institutions to arrange credit facilities and financing for the Group and its subsidiaries.
* Evaluate capital structures and financing arrangements across business entities.
4. Investment & Corporate Development
* Participate in financial due diligence for new investment projects and M&A transactions.
* Evaluate the financial performance and effectiveness of investments in subsidiaries and affiliated companies.
* Provide financial analysis and recommendations to support investment decisions and business restructuring initiatives.
5. Financial Governance & Internal Controls
* Lead the implementation and optimisation of ERP systems and financial management processes across the Group.
* Establish and strengthen internal control frameworks covering key financial and operational processes.
* Identify financial risks, prevent potential losses and ensure transparency across the organisation.
* Drive continuous improvement and digital transformation within the Finance and Accounting function.
6. Leadership & Team Development
* Lead the Finance and Accounting function at Group level.
* Provide strategic direction, technical guidance and professional development for finance and accounting teams across subsidiaries.
* Participate in the recruitment, appointment and development of key finance leadership positions within the Group.
* Establish consistent financial management standards and accountability across the organisation.
requirements_text:
Candidate Requirements
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Accounting, Finance or Auditing.
* Professional qualifications such as ACCA, CPA, CFA or CMA are preferred.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in a comparable senior finance or accounting leadership position within a large corporation, diversified business group or Holding Company structure.
* Experience working in a Big Four accounting firm is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of Vietnamese accounting standards, financial reporting, tax regulations and corporate finance.
* Demonstrated experience in financial consolidation, multi-entity accounting management and Group-level financial governance.
* Experience in financial restructuring, system transformation and ERP implementation is highly desirable.
* Understanding of treasury management, budgeting, cash flow planning and investment evaluation.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, auditors and external advisors.
* Strong leadership and people management capabilities, with the ability to develop and manage finance teams across multiple business entities.
* Strategic thinking, strong analytical skills and the ability to present financial information and recommendations to senior management and the Board of Directors.
* Good command of English for professional working purposes.
* Honest, detail-oriented, proactive, decisive and commercially minded.
